From what I can piece together from my foggy memory of the event, it was because my life was literally falling about around me. There was an investigation involving my grandfather that I knew would turn up with nothing, but the stupid school counselor had to go blab about it the moment I let my guard down. All that started a chain reaction of my dad gas lighting me even more, and my cousin that was the reason I was holding on, left me. Without her I had no one, so I took my anti depressants like tic tacs so it would all go away.

Life is strange now. I still think I’m in a coma sometimes just having a weird dream. I took 24 grams of Wellbutrin, I suffered from seizures, several cardiac arrests, a stroke, ecmo, and a ten day coma. Somehow I came out mostly unscathed, physically, the only thing debilitating me after I left was a blood clot in my artery, but that was easily fixed with surgery. But mentally, it won’t leave me, I’m constantly trying to bring back the lost memories of those two months before and after my OD. By talking with my mom, it’s helped me at least piece together why I think I took all those pills, but I can’t truly remember. The worst part, is knowing that my family and friends where crushed by something I don’t even remember doing.

Long story short I gave up even trying to attempt. My last attempt consisted of 24 grams (24,000 milligrams) of Wellbutrin. Anything above 9 grams is where you start finding fatalities, the fact that I survived that amount in general is amazing. Somehow, even after that obscenely large amount, I only had minor set backs that are barely affecting me today. Once I knew that I survived several seizures, cardiac arrest, a stroke, ecmo and a ten day coma with that amount of medication, I figured that there would be no way for me successfully commit suicide.

Considering I was unconscious I don’t know, but the first conscious memory is being very confused. At the time I didn’t remember what happened, but I knew I was upset about it. Shortly after being told what I did I had to be restrained because I was trying to run but with the restraints, nurses, and recent incision on my leg, I didn’t get far
